paragraphs.text:
You and Norman follow the original trail left by the ape-man. 
It leads you to a hollow in the mountain thickets. The pervasive 
odor, the tracks, and litter indicate to you that the ape-men—
the sasquatches—had camped here but an hour ago.

“Look!” Norman cries, pointing to a figure across the hollow. 
“It’s Sylvia!” You run to her.
Roll 1D10: if the result is even, go to 395; if the result is odd, go to 357.
